speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any family history of breast or ovarian cancer, and have you experienced any skin changes like dimpling or nipple discharge? REQUEST TEST: Mammography

text: RESULTS: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any pain with the mass, and have you noticed any skin redness or warmth in that area? REQUEST TEST: Ultrasound of the breast.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the ultrasound was normal but the mass is rapidly growing and polylobulated on mammography, I need to rule out a benign but aggressive lesion like a phyllodes tumor or a high-grade cancer. Are you currently breastfeeding, and have you noticed any nipple retraction or peau d'orange changes? REQUEST TEST: Core needle biopsy
